### STEP 6 - Manual review only
Run this manually after STEP 5.
This workflow does not send emails and does not create drafts.
It only selects outreach candidates from Perfex and upserts them to the `Outreach Candidates` Google Sheets tab.
Create the `Outreach Candidates` sheet tab before the first run.
Replace the Perfex `authtoken` placeholder before running.
Perfex remains the source of truth.
